title: One-round head-position window
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration with $k$ work tapes, Boolean alphabet, and states in a set of type $S$, on input $x$, and let $a$ be an action for a machine with $k$ work tapes on that input. A configuration $d$ with $k+2$ work tapes on the same input satisfies the one-round window condition if its input-head position is either the position in $c$ or the position after applying $a$ to $c$, and, for every one of the original $k$ work tapes, its corresponding head position is either the position in $c$ or the position after applying $a$ to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: configuration $c$ with $k$ tapes and states in $S$
